text: Coffee with Laila. Her mum's knee replacement is booked for 2 November 2026, first slot at 8am. Laila's taking the week off to look after her. Remind me to text her that evening.

Kevin's back is bad again, slipped a disc lifting the boys' bikes. Physio Thursday at 4. His wife Carmen is doing all the school runs meanwhile and sounds knackered. On top of that their youngest, Milan, has a hospital appointment about his eczema on the 4th at 10.15. Kevin says he'd love one of those back massage cushions for Christmas.
Caught up with Khadija after work. Her son Idris had his tonsils out last Tuesday and is milking it for ice cream. She's back at the office Monday. Should drop round some comics for him.

Duc rang. His dad's been in St Thomas' since the weekend with pneumonia, they're hoping to discharge him Friday morning. Duc's flying down from Glasgow tomorrow at 6am and his sister Mei is already there. He sounded shattered, says his mum isn't coping well on her own at home either. Ring him over the weekend to see how his dad's doing.

Nia - scan results came back clear!! She'd been dreading it for weeks. Celebrating with her partner Bilal at that Turkish place on Saturday at 8. Her mum Hadiza is coming up from Cardiff for it too, first time she's been well enough to travel since her own surgery in March. Nia says she finally feels like she can breathe.
Bilal says his brother Yusuf broke his wrist at five-a-side. Cast for six weeks, so he'll miss the tournament in March 2027. Bilal reckons he's gutted.
Hadiza is nervous about her gallbladder op on the 12th at half 9. Her sister Sadia is driving her in. Must send flowers to the ward afterwards.

Long chat with Aurelio. Mum's dementia getting worse, they're looking at care homes near Leeds. He's struggling with it all, not sleeping much. His daughter Lola starts uni in Sheffield next month which isn't helping the guilt. Check in with him next week, maybe take him for a pint.
Pharmacy closes at 1pm Saturday - pick up repeat prescription before then.

Alana's husband Milan had a minor heart attack on Sunday night. He's home now, cardiac rehab starts 4 January 2027. Alana's holding up but says the kids are scared. Don't forget to ring her Friday afternoon.
Mei told me Kenji (Ken to everyone) has glandular fever and is off school till half term. She's working from home to cover. He's bored out of his mind apparently and asking for Lego.
Tendai's appointment with the consultant got moved to Wednesday 3pm. Ayesha is going with him because he hates hospitals.
Spoke to Michael. His knee surgery was cancelled again, third time, NHS backlog. Now he's thinking of going private in the new year. Mood not great.
Lorenzo's little girl Mia has chickenpox, so the birthday party on Saturday is off. Lorenzo and his wife Elena are rescheduling for some time in December.
Ming had her wisdom teeth out yesterday morning. Face like a hamster, she says. Need to message her tomorrow to see how the swelling is.
Anders - booked in for a hernia repair at the Nuffield on 19 November 2026, 7.30am arrival. Wife Dorota will collect him. He's oddly calm about it.
Dropped by Wiremu's. His dog Kiri had surgery on her leg last week and is wearing the cone of shame. He's sleeping on the sofa to keep her company. Get her one of those chew toys.
Carmen's dad is having a stent fitted tomorrow afternoon. She's flying to Valencia tonight at 10 and back on the 28th. Remind me to WhatsApp her on Thursday.
Sadia's doing much better since the gallbladder op, back on solid food. Hadiza says she's already talking about the gym.

Chen and Lola went to A&E Saturday night - Lola's asthma flared after the fireworks. Kept in overnight, home by Sunday lunchtime. Chen sounded rattled. Lola's got a review with the asthma nurse on Monday 2 November 2026 at 9.30am and Chen wants to go with her. He also mentioned his own blood pressure is up and the GP wants to see him again in December.
Elena's pregnant again! Due in May 2027. Morning sickness is brutal this time though, she's barely eating.
Yuki starts back at work Monday at 9 after three months off with long covid. Phased return, mornings only. She's anxious about it. Text her Sunday night good luck.
Yusuf mentioned his mum's cataract op went well on Friday. She can read the paper again and is thrilled.
Dorota's son Kaito has his MRI on the 7th at 2.15pm, they're checking his headaches. She's trying not to google stuff. I should call her that evening to see what they said.
Note to self: GP appointment Tuesday 22nd at 11.40 about my shoulder. Bring the list of meds.

Laila's mum is recovering well from the knee op, walking with a frame already. Laila's exhausted though, been staying over every night. Her brother Idris is finally coming down from Manchester at the weekend to take over.
Kevin and Carmen are off to Tenerife over February half term, first holiday since his back went. He's hoping the physio has sorted him by then.

Catch-up with Khadija and Nia at lunch. Khadija's dad has been diagnosed with type 2 diabetes and she's overhauling his whole diet, no more pastries. Nia's knee is still swollen from the half marathon on Sunday so she's seeing a sports physio Thursday at 6pm. Both of them are knackered. Must remember to send Nia that foam roller link.
Duc's dad got discharged this morning. Duc's staying with him till Wednesday then heading back.
Hadiza's niece is having grommets put in on the 30th. She's only four so everyone's a bit on edge.
Bilal doesn't eat gluten - coeliac. Worth remembering for the dinner on 14 November.

Milan's out of hospital and itching to get back to work, which Alana is not having. He's been told no driving for a month. Their eldest, Michael, is home from uni to help out. I'll pop round with a lasagne Sunday.
Aurelio found a care home for his mum, she moves in on 1 December 2026. He took the kids to see it at the weekend and it went better than expected. Ask him how the first week goes.
Ayesha - her husband Tendai finally got a diagnosis, it's Crohn's. Starting medication next week. She says it's almost a relief to know what it is.
Mia's chickenpox is clearing up. Lorenzo says the party is now on 6 December at 2pm at the soft play. Need to buy her something, she's turning five and obsessed with unicorns.
Anders texted from the ward - op done, all fine, out tomorrow morning. Dorota is picking him up at 10.
Quick one: Kenji is back at school. Mei relieved.
Wiremu said Kiri's stitches come out Friday at 5. He's been dropping hints that he'd love a dog walker for a couple of weeks while she recovers since he's back in the office.
Ming's mum fell on the ice last winter and still uses a stick. Ming visits her every Sunday in Croydon.
Michael's private consultation is 9 January 2027 at 10am. If they can do it in February he'll go for it. Sounds hopeful at last. Send him the name of the surgeon Anders used.
Chen's working nights at the hospital now, A&E. Hates it but the money's better.
Elena says Lorenzo has been amazing with the morning sickness, doing all the cooking. Her scan is the 18th at 11.20.
Yuki's first week back went okay but she's wiped out by lunchtime. Her manager's being decent about it. Her partner Kaito is cooking every night.
Mrs Brennan next door had her hip done on Monday. Her daughter is staying for a fortnight. Might take round some soup.

Talked to Sadia for ages. Her brother Yusuf is moving back in with their parents while his wrist heals, can't drive or cook. Their mum loves it, Yusuf less so. Sadia herself has a job interview at the Royal Free on Friday at 2pm, nervous because it's a big step up. Text her good luck Friday morning.
Kevin's mum has shingles. He's doing her shopping on Tuesdays and Thursdays.
Dentist moved to Monday 9am. Annoying.

Hadiza said Dr Popescu told her to take another two weeks off. Her stitches are healing but she's still sore. She's binge-watching Bake Off and says she wants to learn to make sourdough when she's better. Maybe a sourdough starter kit as a get-well thing.

Lunch with Idris and his wife Khadija. Their youngest has an ear infection again, third this year, and they've been referred to ENT for 15 January 2027 at 4.30pm. Idris is worried she'll need grommets like her cousin. Khadija's more relaxed. Their other two are fine and both mad about swimming. Should ask Khadija after the ENT appointment what they said.
Laila's brother Idris made it down at the weekend, finally. Laila went home and slept for 14 hours.
Tendai's on the new meds and already feeling a bit better. He and Ayesha are thinking of a short break in March 2027 if he keeps improving.
Kaito's MRI was clear - just migraines. Dorota is so relieved. He's got a follow-up with the neurologist next Thursday at 3.
Nia's knee: physio says it's a strain, not a tear. Six weeks no running. She's devastated about missing the Brighton marathon in April 2027.
Alana's birthday is the 9th. With everything going on with Milan she won't be doing anything, so I should organise something small. Maybe drinks Friday 8th at 7.
Carmen's dad's stent went fine. She's back from Valencia on the 28th, landing at 11pm, and wants a proper catch-up the weekend after.

Bilal's dad had a fall at home last night, nothing broken but bad bruising. They're getting a stairlift fitted on 3 November. Bilal's also sorting a personal alarm for him. Remind me to ask Bilal how his dad's getting on.
Ayesha's daughter Mia passed her driving test today, first go! Ayesha's terrified already.
Lola is back at uni after the asthma scare, Chen drove her up yesterday. New inhaler seems to be working.
Mum asked me to come with her to the eye clinic on Wednesday at 1.45. I'm taking the afternoon off.

Kenji's grandad (Mei's dad) is in hospital in Osaka with a chest infection. Mei is flying out on Saturday 7 November, possibly for two weeks. She's worried and keeps checking her phone. I need to message her before she goes and offer to water the plants.
